from datetime import date, datetime
import time


local_tuple = time.localtime(0)
text = time.ctime(0)
timestamp = time.mktime(local_tuple)
local_date = date.fromtimestamp(0)
local_datetime = datetime.fromtimestamp(0)
localized = local_datetime.astimezone()
timezone = None
nullable = datetime.fromtimestamp(0, timezone)
literal_null = datetime.fromtimestamp(0, **{"tz": None})
time_options: dict[str, object] = {}
unknown_timezone = datetime.fromtimestamp(0, **time_options)
